notes:
Specialized clothing designed to protect the wearer from hazardous materials, radiation, chemicals, or biological agents. Became widely recognized in Japan through news coverage of nuclear decontamination work and pandemic response.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防護服|ぼうごふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}する→着用する：26849_chakuyousuru⟧: to wear a protective suit
- {防護服|ぼうごふく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be clad in a protective suit
- ⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧{防護服|ぼうごふく}: full-body protective suit
- ⟦{放射線|ほうしゃせん}→放射線：14998_houshasen⟧{防護服|ぼうごふく}: radiation protection suit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{防護|ぼうご}→防護：23019_bougo⟧⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧: protective mask — covers the face only
- ⟦{作業服|さぎょうふく}→作業服：16786_sagyoufuku⟧: work clothes — general workwear, not necessarily hazard-resistant
- ⟦{防弾|ぼうだん}→防弾：30754_boudan⟧チョッキ: bulletproof vest — protects against projectiles, not chemical or biological hazards
